Food & Drink Menus

A delectable international beachfront menu featuring local, fresh, and vibrant flavors, complemented by our extensive selection of wines and handcrafted cocktails.

Finger Bites & Starters Salads Mains, Pasta & Steak Local Thai Dishes Desserts
Champagne & Prosecco Red, White & Rosé Wine Signature Cocktails Classic Cocktails Spirits, Aperitifs & Liqueurs Beers Soft Drinks, Juices, Smoothies & Other Drinks

Main menu available from 12 pm - 10 pm. Cooking time can take up to 30 minutes unless otherwise noted. All prices are in THB, inclusive of VAT and subject to a 10% service charge — (v) suitable for vegetarians, (n) contains nuts, (p) contains pork.
